title: 2. koşul: If I had…, I would…
explain_tr: **2. koşul (Second Conditional)** şimdi ya da gelecekte **gerçek olmayan / hayalî** durumları anlatır. Türkçedeki *"Param olsa, ev alırdım"* yapısı.
Kalıp: **If + Past Simple, … would + V1**: *If I **had** more money, I **would buy** a house.* Geçmiş zaman kullanılıyor ama anlam **şimdi**: şu anda param yok.

**be** fiilinde tüm kişiler için **were** kullanılır (özellikle resmî dilde): *If I **were** you, I **would** take the job.* (Senin yerinde olsam…) *If I was* gündelik konuşmada duyulur ama sınavlarda ve yazıda **were** tercih et.
En sık hatalar: if'li kısımda **would** kullanmak (*If I would have time* ✗) ve ana cümlede **would**'u düşürmek (*If I had time, I go* ✗). Kural: **would** sadece if'siz kısımda.

1. koşulla karşılaştır: *If it **rains** tomorrow, I **will** stay home* (gerçekten olabilir). *If I **won** the lottery, I **would** travel* (pek olası değil, hayal). *would* yerine **could** (yapabilirdim) veya **might** (belki yapardım) de gelebilir.
explain_en: Second conditional: If + past simple, would + base verb. It describes unreal or unlikely present/future situations. Use 'were' for all persons in formal English: If I were you…
Do not use 'would' in the if-clause.
table: If I **have** time, I **will** call you.
If I **had** time, I **would** call you.

pairs.wrong: If I would have a car, I would drive to work.
pairs.right: If I had a car, I would drive to work.
pairs.note_tr: if kısmında **would** olmaz → Past Simple: had.

pairs.wrong: If I was you, I will accept the offer.
pairs.right: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
pairs.note_tr: Tavsiye kalıbı: If I **were** you, I **would**…

pairs.wrong: If she knew the answer, she tells us.
pairs.right: If she knew the answer, she would tell us.

pairs.wrong: If I win the lottery, I would buy an island.
pairs.right: If I won the lottery, I would buy an island.

exercises.prompt: If I ___ (have) more free time, I would learn to play the guitar.
answer: had

exercises.prompt: If I were you, I ___ (talk) to your manager about it.
answer: would talk
'd talk

exercises.prompt: If she ___ (live) closer, we would see each other more often.
answer: lived

exercises.prompt: What would you do if you ___ (find) a wallet in the street?
answer: found

exercises.prompt: If it ___ (be) not so expensive, I would buy it.
answer: were
was

exercises.prompt: "Senin yerinde olsam, o işi kabul ederdim."
options: If I am you, I will accept that job.
If I were you, I would accept that job.
If I would be you, I accepted that job.
If I were you, I accept that job.
answer: If I were you, I would accept that job.
exercises.explain_tr: If I were you + would + V1.

options: If I would know his number, I would call him.
If I knew his number, I would call him.
If I knew his number, I will call him.
If I know his number, I would call him.
answer: If I knew his number, I would call him.

exercises.prompt: Which situation is the LEAST likely?
options: If it rains, we'll stay inside.
If I see Ali, I'll tell him.
If I were a bird, I would fly to Kashgar.
If you heat ice, it melts.
answer: If I were a bird, I would fly to Kashgar.

exercises.prompt: If I would have enough money, I would travel around the world.
answer: If I had enough money, I would travel around the world.
If I had enough money, I'd travel around the world.

exercises.prompt: If he studied harder, he can pass the exam.
answer: If he studied harder, he could pass the exam.
If he studied harder, he would pass the exam.

exercises.prompt: I would buy a bigger flat if I earn more.
answer: I would buy a bigger flat if I earned more.
